Container.Name: wsd-scan
Container.Overview: WSD push-scan to email for WSD-capable printers. Each destination appears on the printer under Scan - Computer (WSD); scans are emailed as PDF. Pick the printer, view its features and configure destinations and the mail server in the web UI.

Config.Name: App folder
Config.Description: Folder containing wsdscan.py (a clone of the repository)

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port of the config page (host networking)

Config.Name: Printer IP
Config.Description: Optional: printer IP to start with (give it a DHCP reservation). The printer can also be found and picked in the web UI.

Config.Name: Advertise IP
Config.Description: Optional: Unraid IP the printer should call back, if auto-detection picks the wrong one
